## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` needs a fix because it tells users to avoid "shall", and with `require_shall=True` the validator rejects every criterion written that way.

## Changes
This pull request rewrites `CRITERION_HINT` to recommend direct action bullets without "shall" and rewrites `BULLET_HINT` to show the exact `- ` prefix. It also adds a root-level `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the hint match the require_shall option — If `require_shall=True`, a user who follows the new hint and writes `- Save the result` is rejected, because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (app/criteria.py:8). `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts this rejection, and `require_shall` is a documented option in `config.example.yml:1`. — Deployments that enable `require_shall` give users guidance that makes every compliant criterion fail validation. — Fix: Pick the hint based on `require_shall`, or remove the "without the word shall" clause so the hint holds under both options.
